demos.title: Claude Code 的 mods
demos.line: 暗色科技发布：讲者在左，右边一个原创界面窗口随口播装上面板、拦截命令、斜杠命令。
demos.line_en: Dark Tech Keynote: the host on the left, an original UI window on the right that gains a pane, a command guard and slash commands as they speak.

demos.title: Muse：把事情交给它
demos.line: 等距信息图：讲者缩成右上角小窗，镜头沿一块沙盘横移，四个工位讲清 Muse 的系统。
demos.line_en: Isometric Infographic: the host shrinks to a corner window while the camera travels along a diorama of four stations.

demos.title: Muse：把事情交给它吗？
demos.title_en: Muse: would you hand it your tasks?
demos.line: 讲者本身就生成在等距小世界里演内容，视频当主画面，两侧用标签卡和引线补上名字、日期和来源。
demos.line_en: The host is generated inside the isometric world and acts the story out; the video is the main picture, with callout cards adding names, dates and sources.

demos.title: Dots：把事情交给它
demos.line: 瑞士动态排版：讲者在自己的瑞士海报棚里演内容，页底色取自视频本身；一颗绿点是全片唯一不吸附网格的元素。
demos.line_en: Swiss Motion Graphics: the host acts in a Swiss-poster studio of their own, the page colour taken from the video itself; one green dot is the only element that leaves the grid.

demos.title: Dots（竖屏版）
demos.line: 竖屏 9:16 的“视频即世界”：视频铺满画面，底色取自视频，标注卡贴在两侧并用引线指进视频，逐字高亮的大字幕避开平台界面区。
demos.line_en: Portrait 9:16 "video as the world": the video fills the frame, the ground colour comes from the video, callout cards sit on the edges with leaders into it, and karaoke captions stay clear of the platform UI.

demos.title: claude-video 介绍（翻牌显示屏）
demos.line: 科技感高铁站里一块被整块重画的机械翻牌板：逐帧跟踪镜头的透视，右边的预览窗是一块会翻的大翻牌，随口播放出各种风格的样片；博主手里的白卡片也被换成会变的票；博主身后依次出现各风格的大字和小角色（水墨鹤、像素猫、霓虹鱼、折纸鹤）；他挡在板和背景前，哗啦声由两万多次翻牌合成。
demos.line_en: The board in a high-tech rail station is redrawn as a real mechanical split-flap display, tracked frame by frame. Its preview window is a giant flap that shows samples of many styles in step with the voice, the blank white card in the host's hand becomes a changing ticket, big style-name type and little creatures (ink crane, pixel cat, neon fish, paper crane) appear behind him, and the host stays in front. The clatter is synthesised from 20,000+ flaps.
